cohort: intersection of accepted locus keys across both sources and both spacing policies, requiring selected kind and locator in every case
unit: case-preserving ASCII letter count of each encoded token, not manuscript glyph count
metric: equal-locus mean of first-token length minus mean remaining-token length
null: independently choose a uniformly random token as first within each fixed locus; remaining tokens retain their multiset
randomness: SHA-256 counter draws with rejection sampling; source ID, spacing policy, replicate index and locus key are included in each draw
inference_limit: descriptive conditioned shuffle comparison; no confirmatory p-value, unseen-material claim, language identification, decipherment or translation
